item.title: You're invited to 2 days of data viz celebration and inspiration!
item.description: Join us at the Maryland Institute College of Art for two days of networking and inspiration with industry leaders and creators of shortlisted IIB Awards works.

item.title: Information is Beautiful Awards 2023: The Winners
item.description: This past weekend, we welcomed over 150 attendees for two days filled with data visualization inspiration and celebrations. The Day of Inspiration mini conference on Friday covered topics ranging from what a career in data viz looks like to communicating water quality data through sonic vibrations to questioning our data culture.

item.title: How to submit your entry: step-by-step video walkthrough
item.description: Learn to submit your entry with this video walkthrough presented by our program manager!

item.title: Announcing the 2024 Longlist
item.description: The longlist has been announced! Check out the entry showcase to see this year’s entries, including nearly 1,000 entries that have been selected for the longlist. Thank you to everyone who entered into this year’s showcase. We have 9 categories of excellence and this month we are going to explore the behind the scenes of the beautiful showcase.

item.title: Announcing the 2024 Shortlist
item.description: The shortlist has been announced! Check out the entry showcase to see 89 entries on the shortlist. Our judges will begin reviewing shortlisted entries and select final winners for each category. Winners will be announced at the Awards Ceremony on June 12th.

item.title: Community vote is open: vote for your favorite shortlisted work
item.description: With the announcement of the shortlist last week, we are entering the final judging phase to determine the 2024 winners across 9 categories and 7 Special Awards. While our panel of judges finalize the winners for each category, we invite you to cast your vote on your favorite work! The Community Vote, which opens today, is a Special Award that all shortlisted entries are eligible to win. The winner of this Award will take home a $1,000 cash prize.

item.title: Announcing the 2024 Winners!
item.description: We’re thrilled to unveil the winners of the 2024 Information is Beautiful Awards. This year’s entries pushed the boundaries of what data visualization can achieve—telling powerful stories, illuminating hidden patterns, and making the complex beautifully clear.

item.title: Thank You to Our Incredible Volunteers
item.description: We want to thank this year's dedicated Information is Beautiful Awards program who made this year's program extra specialVolunteers are the backbone of the Information Is Beautiful Awards, and we are deeply grateful for their incredible efforts and dedication.
